clue.text: Fruitful source of information

parts.note: a source of news and rumour pictured as a fruit-bearing climbing plant, the informal channel by which gossip spreads

explanation.definitionFit: Hearing something on the grapevine means learning it through gossip, and the plant also bears fruit, hence 'fruitful'.

clue.text: Peer has agitated for reform

indicators.note: agitated means stirred up, so the letters of the two words before it are shaken into a new order

explanation.surface: A lord in the House stirs up support for political reform.
explanation.walkthrough: 'agitated' rearranges PEER and HAS, seven letters in all.
explanation.definitionFit: To reform something is to give it a new form, a synonym for remould.

clue.text: Philosopher attached to a body of soldiers

parts.note: Plato was the ancient Greek philosopher
on can mean attached to, as a label is on a jar

explanation.surface: An ancient thinker is assigned to an army unit.
explanation.definitionFit: A platoon is a small military unit, a subdivision of a company.

clue.text: Give legal force to girl with new idea accepting model

parts.note: Val is a girl's name, short for Valerie

indicators.note: accepting means taking something in, so the model goes inside the rearranged letters
new signals the following word is made afresh, its letters rearranged

parts.note: the Model T was Ford's famous car, so model gives T

explanation.surface: A lawyer ratifies a young woman's fresh notion, which takes in some example.
explanation.walkthrough: 'new' turns IDEA into IDAE, and 'accepting' puts T inside it to make IDATE after VAL.
explanation.definitionFit: To validate a contract or document is to make it legally binding or officially approved.

clue.text: Slip by the continental church feature

parts.note: el is 'the' in Spanish, a continental language
an apse is the vaulted semicircular end of a church

explanation.surface: Someone slips past a feature of a European church.
explanation.definitionFit: Time that slips by is said to pass or go by unnoticed.

clue.text: Declaration will reveal nothing

parts.note: to manifest is to show or reveal plainly
O, the round figure zero, stands for nothing

explanation.surface: A public statement that will disclose nothing at all.
explanation.definitionFit: A party publishes a manifesto as a public statement of its policies and aims.

clue.text: It is fallacious about to be in eluded with all the members of a profession

definitions.text: all the members of a profession

indicators.note: to be included means placed inside, so the short word for about goes into the other piece

parts.note: fallacious reasoning is faulty, based on error
c, short for circa, means about

explanation.surface: Someone argues it is mistaken to lump in every member of a profession.
explanation.walkthrough: 'to be included' puts C (circa) inside FAULTY.
explanation.definitionFit: The faculty can mean the whole body of members of a profession, especially doctors or lawyers.

clue.text: Gazing about

definitions.meaning: looking steadily at something, to regard being to look at
concerning or on the subject of

explanation.definitionFit: To regard is to look at attentively, and the same word as a preposition means concerning.

clue.text: Unauthorised divulgation of water escaping

definitions.meaning: the release of secret information without permission
fluid seeping out through a hole or crack

explanation.definitionFit: Secrets that get out are called a leak, just as water dripping from a pipe is.

clue.text: Dolt and lieutenant accept gold in the attack

parts.note: an ass is a fool or dolt
Au is the chemical symbol for gold

explanation.surface: A fool and a junior officer pocket gold during a raid.
explanation.walkthrough: 'accept' puts AU inside LT, giving LAUT after ASS.
explanation.definitionFit: An assault is a violent onslaught, the same as an offensive or charge.

clue.text: Flower stiffly formal and acceptable with the French

parts.note: prim means stiffly correct and proper
U means upper-class and so socially acceptable
la is the feminine 'the' in French

explanation.surface: A demure bloom is deemed proper alongside a French one.
explanation.walkthrough: U for acceptable comes from the old British idea of 'U' (upper-class) versus 'non-U' manners.
explanation.definitionFit: Primula is the genus of plants that includes primroses and cowslips.

clue.text: May has lots of cuddles

parts.note: may and can both express permission
oodles means lots, a great amount

explanation.surface: A woman named May has plenty of hugs to give.
explanation.walkthrough: 'May' looks like a name or month but is the verb of permission.
explanation.definitionFit: To canoodle is to kiss and hug amorously.

clue.text: Important time certain for removal

parts.note: an era is a significant period of history
sure means certain

explanation.surface: A momentous period is definitely due for clearing away.
explanation.definitionFit: An erasure is a rubbing out or deletion, the act of wiping something away.

clue.text: Showed indignation having been despatched in a rush

indicators.note: in tells us the word for despatched sits inside the plant word

parts.note: a rush is a reed-like marsh plant
despatched means sent off

explanation.surface: Someone resented being hastily sent off.
explanation.walkthrough: 'rush' reads as haste but is the waterside plant.
explanation.definitionFit: To have resented something is to have felt bitter at an unfair situation.

clue.text: Apple used for curdling milk

definitions.meaning: a variety of dessert apple, also called reinette
an extract from a calf's stomach that sets milk into curds for cheese

explanation.definitionFit: The same word names an old variety of apple and the enzyme preparation cheese-makers add to milk.

clue.text: Hurried, fired and searched thoroughly

parts.note: ran means hurried
sacked means dismissed, fired from a job

explanation.surface: A worker rushed off, lost the job, and the place was turned over.
explanation.definitionFit: A room that has been ransacked has been rummaged through roughly, often by burglars.

clue.text: Mayfly left existing only for a day

parts.note: Ephemera is the genus of mayflies, insects that live a single day as adults

explanation.surface: A mayfly departed, living only for a single day.
explanation.definitionFit: Something ephemeral is fleeting or short-lived, originally lasting a day.

clue.text: Last to refuse to give up

definitions.meaning: keep going stubbornly in spite of obstacles

explanation.definitionFit: The verb covers both continuing in existence and stubbornly carrying on.

clue.text: Case of the blackleg and poet

parts.note: a scab is a strike-breaker, a blackleg
a bard is a poet

explanation.surface: The legal matter of the strike-breaker and the versifier.
explanation.walkthrough: A blackleg is British slang for a worker who breaks a strike.
explanation.definitionFit: A scabbard is a sheath that holds a sword or dagger.

clue.text: It is hard to get rain all over the place

indicators.note: all over the place means scattered in disorder, so these letters are jumbled

explanation.surface: A complaint that a hard rain is falling everywhere.
explanation.walkthrough: 'all over the place' rearranges GET and RAIN.
explanation.definitionFit: Granite is a notably hard igneous rock, used as the very image of hardness.

clue.text: Making do with a stone

definitions.meaning: managing or getting by in difficulty
a stone from the top course of a wall, usually sloped to shed rain

explanation.definitionFit: The word means managing a difficulty, and also the capping stones laid along the top of a wall.

clue.text: Flexible record returned as it jumped about

indicators.note: returned means sent back, so the abbreviation is read backwards

parts.note: LP is a long-playing record

indicators.note: jumped about means leapt around, so the letters are mixed up

parts.note: c, short for circa, means about

explanation.surface: A bendy record came back as it bounced around.
explanation.walkthrough: 'returned' turns LP into PL; 'jumped' rearranges AS IT into ASTI; 'about' gives C.
explanation.definitionFit: Something plastic can be moulded or bent into shape, being pliable.

clue.text: Ornament allowed after hug

indicators.note: after says the word for allowed follows the word for hug

parts.note: to neck is to kiss and cuddle
let means allowed

explanation.surface: A piece of jewellery was permitted after an embrace.
explanation.definitionFit: A necklet is a decorative band or chain worn round the throat.

clue.text: Wizard concocts errors about this in France

indicators.note: about means surrounding, so the remixed letters go round the French word
concocts means cooks up, so the letters of the next word are remixed

parts.note: ce is French for this

explanation.surface: A magician brews up mistakes about this in France.
explanation.walkthrough: 'concocts' turns ERRORS into SORRER, and 'about' puts CE inside it.
explanation.definitionFit: A sorcerer practises magic, a magician or warlock.

clue.text: One's total possessions, a broken tea-set

indicators.note: broken means smashed, so the letters of the china are rearranged

explanation.surface: Someone's whole fortune amounts to a smashed set of crockery.
explanation.definitionFit: A person's estate is everything owned, especially at death.

clue.text: Image of doctor left in a spirited meeting

indicators.note: in places the doctor and left inside the meeting

parts.note: a seance is a gathering to contact spirits
MB, Bachelor of Medicine, is a doctor's degree

explanation.surface: A picture of a medic left at a lively gathering.
explanation.walkthrough: 'spirited' suggests lively but means involving spirits.
explanation.definitionFit: A semblance is an outward appearance or likeness of something.

clue.text: Satisfied with what is inside

definitions.meaning: the material held in a container

explanation.definitionFit: Stressed one way the word means pleased; stressed the other, the stuff contained.

clue.text: Mundane Hartley product

indicators.note: product means something made, so the name's letters are turned into something new

explanation.surface: A dull item manufactured by a firm named Hartley.
explanation.definitionFit: Earthly means worldly, belonging to this world rather than heaven.

clue.text: Competitor in his element ran through

indicators.note: in signals that the letters are found inside the run of words that follows

explanation.surface: A contestant in a favourite field ran through.
explanation.definitionFit: An entrant is someone who enters a contest, a participant.

clue.text: Root out Liberal not finishing in summer in France

indicators.note: in places the trimmed word inside the French summer

parts.note: ete is French for summer

indicators.note: not finishing means the final letter is missing

parts.note: radical is a sense of liberal in politics

explanation.surface: Uproot the Liberal who did not finish in summer in France.
explanation.walkthrough: 'not finishing' cuts RADICAL to RADICA, which 'in' places inside ETE.
explanation.definitionFit: To eradicate is to destroy completely, literally to pull up by the roots.
